module.name: no-for-in
module.description: Disallow for..in loops without automatically changing inherited-key iteration.

scenarios.name: should allow for-of and explicit own-key iteration
scenarios.given: a for-of loop or Object.keys iteration

scenarios.name: should report for-in without rewriting inherited-key behavior
scenarios.given: a for-in loop over an object with inherited enumerable keys
scenarios.then: a noForIn violation is reported without an autofix

scenarios.name: should report assignment-left and nested for-in loops without autofix
scenarios.given: a nested for-in loop with an assignment target
scenarios.then: a noForIn violation is reported without changing the loop
